title: Dataset root descriptor
description: Optional root descriptor (dataset.json) a design-data dataset MAY carry to declare which optional directories are present, pin the targeted spec version, and override default discovery paths. Absence of this file is not an error; see spec/dataset-layout.md.

specVersion.description: The spec version this dataset targets (e.g. "1.0.0-draft").

layoutRevision.description: The visual layout revision the recipes were authored against (spec/component-visuals.md). A renderer whose revision differs from this one warns, because the same recipe can lay out differently; the design-data CLI refuses a dataset whose revision is newer than its own. A dataset without the field is revision 0.

requires.description: What the dataset needs from the engine that reads it. A dataset without this object asks for nothing, so data released before it existed is not checked.

cli.description: The oldest design-data CLI that can read this dataset correctly, as an exact version (for example "0.40.0"), not a range. A dataset says what it needs, not what future CLIs will do; a breaking layout change is covered by layoutRevision.

directories.description: Declares which registered directories the dataset provides. List a directory key with the value true to declare it present and authoritative; omit the key otherwise. The value is constrained to true so the flag cannot be used to negate a directory's presence (in particular it cannot waive the required tokens/ directory).

paths.description: Optional overrides for the default discovery paths, relative to the dataset root. When omitted, tooling uses the conventional directory names defined in spec/dataset-layout.md.
